scripts.clean: node -e "try{['node_modules','dist'].forEach(d=>require('fs').rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:8,retryDelay:150}))}catch(e){console.error('Clean failed: a file is locked (dev server still running?). Stop it with Ctrl+C, then run npm run clean again.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.update: npm run verify && git add -A && git commit -m "Update GAHM demo" && git push
scripts.uninstall-demo: npm run clean && node -e "try{['.git','.vercel'].forEach(d=>require('fs').rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:8,retryDelay:150}))}catch(e){console.error('Uninstall warning: could not fully remove local state.');process.exit(1)}console.log('Local installation removed. Hosted site still live until you delete it in the dashboard.')"
